content.description: Telcoin is a blockchain-based financial platform that connects mobile telecom networks with digital assets to deliver low-cost remittances and stablecoin banking. Through the Telcoin Wallet, users can hold and send crypto and stablecoins, convert to and from local currencies, and move money across borders cheaply using mobile-first rails. The platform's TEL token exists on both Ethereum and Polygon, with the Telcoin App running primarily on Polygon, and the company has pursued a regulated 'Digital Asset Bank' charter in the US to issue compliant stablecoins such as its eUSD. Targeting both consumers and businesses, especially in remittance-heavy corridors, Telcoin aims to combine the reach of telecom operators with on-chain settlement to make sending money as easy and affordable as sending a text.
